name: 空白数据表
description: 从一个干净的文本字段开始，自由搭建你的业务数据表。
descriptionEn: Start from a clean text field and build your own business table.

name: 项目管理
description: 开箱即用的项目任务管理模板，包含任务状态、负责人、进度、优先级、时间计划、附件以及表格、甘特、看板、日历视图。
descriptionEn: Ready-to-use project and task management with status, assignee, progress, priority, schedule, attachments, and grid, Gantt, board, and calendar views.

name: 敏捷迭代计划
description: 管理迭代任务、故事点、负责人和交付节奏，用看板、甘特与日历统一推进研发迭代。
descriptionEn: Plan sprint tasks, story points, owners and delivery cadence with board, Gantt and calendar views.

name: 里程碑跟踪
description: 围绕关键里程碑、进度、风险与交付物建立项目级时间线，适合阶段性目标跟踪。
descriptionEn: Track project milestones, progress, risks and deliverables on a shared timeline.

name: 产品需求池
description: 统一收集、评审、排期并跟踪产品需求，从需求池到上线日历形成完整研发协作链路。
descriptionEn: Capture, review, schedule and track product requirements from backlog to release calendar.

name: 缺陷跟踪
description: 管理缺陷严重程度、处理状态、负责人和修复日期，支持缺陷看板与修复日历。
descriptionEn: Track bug severity, status, owner and fix dates with board and calendar views.

name: 销售 CRM
description: 管理客户、销售阶段、负责人、预计金额与跟进计划，用漏斗看板推进商机转化。
descriptionEn: Manage accounts, sales stages, owners, forecast amounts and follow-ups in a lightweight CRM.

name: 客户成功跟进
description: 持续跟踪客户健康度、续约状态、合同到期与行动计划，提前识别续约风险。
descriptionEn: Track account health, renewal status, contract dates and follow-up actions.

name: 内容日历
description: 统一管理选题、创作、审核、渠道和发布时间，让内容生产与发布节奏清晰可见。
descriptionEn: Plan topics, production, review, channels and publish dates in one content calendar.

name: 营销活动管理
description: 从活动筹备、预算和排期到执行与复盘，使用看板、甘特和日历协同运营活动。
descriptionEn: Coordinate campaign planning, budget, schedule, execution and review across multiple views.

name: 招聘流程
description: 从简历筛选、面试到 Offer 和入职，统一管理候选人、招聘阶段、评价和面试安排。
descriptionEn: Manage candidates from screening and interviews through offer and onboarding.

name: 员工入职清单
description: 按账号权限、设备、培训和团队融入等模块拆解入职事项，明确负责人和截止日期。
descriptionEn: Coordinate account access, equipment, training and team onboarding tasks with clear owners and deadlines.

name: 费用报销台账
description: 记录费用类型、金额、申请人、审批状态和凭证，形成清晰可追踪的费用台账。
descriptionEn: Track expense categories, amounts, submitters, approval status and receipts.

name: 采购管理
description: 覆盖采购需求、供应商、金额、询价、采购进度与到货日期，集中管理采购过程。
descriptionEn: Track purchase requests, vendors, spend, sourcing status and expected delivery dates.

name: 资产台账
description: 管理资产编号、分类、使用状态、使用人、存放位置和保修信息，适合企业资产盘点。
descriptionEn: Manage asset IDs, categories, assignment, location and warranty information.

name: 库存管理
description: 管理 SKU、库存数量、安全库存、仓库和库存状态，快速识别低库存与缺货物料。
descriptionEn: Track SKUs, on-hand quantities, safety stock, warehouses and low-stock conditions.
